title: Supplemental workflow-pattern references
scope: References outside the fixed 288-source manifest; not counted as catalog rows or runtime integrations.

sources.name: tox
provenance: Official tox README and GitHub license metadata inspected; upstream HEAD d947dd4e43388f727bb534c3f0ad7997d76b4767; accessed 2026-10-15.
discoveries: tox standardizes repeatable development tasks and test runs across isolated environments; repository includes tox.toml and a dedicated test suite.
Useful transferable pattern is one named, deterministic validation entry point for local and CI workflows, with environment/dependency isolation.
tox is Python tooling, so it does not fit SYLPH’s TypeScript runtime and would add no trading capability.
sources.sylphUse: Pattern reference only: express named checks using existing package scripts and CI rather than installing tox or introducing a Python dependency.
validation: If adapting the pattern, preserve the existing TypeScript toolchain and verify local/CI commands produce equivalent results.
